title: Joint bicarbonate–anion-gap stress adds no established cross-cycle prediction of combined grip strength
abstract: A frozen joint low-bicarbonate/high-corrected-anion-gap feature did not establish improved combined-grip prediction in NHANES adults aged 50+: target delta RMSE +0.000379 kg (paired conditional 95% interval -0.002520 to +0.003221 kg). A bounded negative independent-sample predictive comparison, not equivalence or a causal claim.
